notice: 4 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, recaptured from game source 346f798 after the district fidelity pass. Open any picture at its original size.
setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.

Viewpoints that differ from the dc93023f gallery — kayak-landing: Same standing point as dc93023f; the look is raised from -39 degrees at the water to -8 degrees and turned west so the boat, pier and beach are in frame.
The captured High-quality frames reach 1,006,064 triangles / 205 draw calls.

Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted). Earlier collections in this record were rendered with SwiftShader, so small shading and anti-aliasing differences are not scene changes.
